events.title: Middle East Conflict Escalation
events.summary: The ongoing conflict in the Middle East has escalated, with multiple countries involved. This has led to increased tensions and a higher risk of further escalation. The US and other countries have imposed sanctions and tariffs on certain countries, which could lead to a trade war.
events.reasoning: The conflict in the Middle East has led to increased tensions and a higher risk of further escalation. This could lead to a decrease in oil production and an increase in oil prices, making oil services stocks more attractive. On the other hand, emerging markets could be negatively affected by the conflict and trade war.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the situation closely and adjust the position as needed

events.exitStrategy: Close the position if the conflict de-escalates or if oil prices decrease significantly

gains.extendedNote: If the conflict leads to a full-scale war

otherFactors: Monitor the situation in the Middle East closely
Watch for any changes in oil prices
